title: [4.6] Android: Crash on initialization due to NoSuchMethodError in GodotNetUtils.openURI
body: ### Tested versions v4.6.1.rc.mono.custom_build [0227be0bd] ### System information Godot v4.6.1.rc.mono (0227be0bd) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7688) - AMD Ryzen 7 9700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 47.65 GiB memory ### Issue description The Android application crashes immediately during the engine initialization phase. Based on the logcat output, the crash is triggered by a JNI error: NoSuchMethodError when attempting to call org.godotengine.godot.utils.GodotNetUtils.openURI. This suggests a mismatch between the Godot Android library (AAR/Export Templates) and the engine's native code, or that the method has been stripped/obfuscated during the build process. Expected behavior: The engine should initialize successfully without JNI errors, and the openURI method should be accessible for network-related tasks. System information Godot version: v4.6.1.rc.mono.custom_build [0227be0bd] OS: Android 15 Device: One Plus Ace6 Log Files `java_vm_ext.cc:621] JNI DETECTED ERROR IN APPLICATION: JNI GetMethodID called with pending exception java.lang.NoSuchMethodError: no non-static method "Lorg/godotengine/godot/utils/GodotNetUtils;.openURI(Ljava/lang/String;)I" at boolean org.godotengine.godot.GodotLib.initialize(org.godotengine.godot.Godot, android.content.res.AssetManager, org.godotengine.godot.GodotIO, org.godotengine.godot.utils.GodotNetUtils, org.godotengine.godot.io.directory.DirectoryAccessHandler, org.godotengine.godot.io.file.FileAccessHandler, boolean) (GodotLib.java:-2) at boolean org.godotengine.godot.Godot.initEngine(org.godotengine.godot.GodotHost, java.util.List, java.util.Set) (Godot.kt:338) ... java_vm_ext.cc:621] in call to GetMethodID java_vm_ext.cc:621] from boolean org.godotengine.godot.GodotLib.initialize(...) runtime.cc:719] Runtime aborting... ` ### Steps to reproduce Configure an Android export preset in Godot. Export the project to an APK or AAB. Install the application on an Android device/emulator. Launch the application. The app crashes immediately on the splash screen. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A (Not applicable). This is a JNI/Engine initialization crash that occurs before any project-specific logic is executed. The stack trace clearly indicates a NoSuchMethodError for GodotNetUtils.openURI within the Godot Android library itself. This can be observed with any empty project exported to Android.
